title: Health Services Criteria: Arrival Review Window for Assisted Living Respite Guests
content:
The arrival review window of a guest on an Assisted Living Respite Stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is a number of days after the check-in date, and it depends on whether the guest also lives in Larkspur independent living and for how long.

**Criterion.** The arrival review window is three days (3 days) for a guest who holds an active Larkspur independent living residency whose move-in date is at least thirty-six whole months (36 whole months) before the current date, two days (2 days) for a guest who holds an active Larkspur independent living residency whose move-in date is fewer than thirty-six whole months before the current date, and one day (1 day) for any other guest.

The residency read is the guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement in active status, and its move-in date; the whole months are counted from that move-in date to the current date.

## Window by guest

| Guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement | Whole months since its move-in date | Arrival review window |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 36 or more | 3 days |
| Active | Fewer than 36 | 2 days |
| None active (none held, or held in another status such as reserved, notice given or vacated) | — | 1 day |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Move-in date of the active residency | Current date | Whole months | Window |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2023 | 15 March 2026 | 36 | 3 days — exactly 36 counts as at least 36 |
| 15 March 2023 | 14 March 2026 | 35 | 2 days |
| 2 January 2026 | 15 March 2026 | 2 | 2 days |

A guest whose Independent Living Residency Agreement was vacated before the stay holds no active residency, so the window is 1 day however long the earlier residency ran.
